description: ChichemistAZE is a solo-research initiative focusing on the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge. Passionate about applying chemistry, materials science, and data-driven insights to agriculture. The project integrates NASA's Earth observation data (SMAP, ECOSTRESS, GPM, Landsat) to develop practical, farmer-friendly crop-rotation strategies that enhance soil health and climate resilience.
summary:
C.h.e.MartixAZE (Chemistry & Healthy Ecosystems Matrix AZE) is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support system designed to help farmers adapt to rapid climate shifts. Addressing the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge, our platform bridges satellite observations with soil chemistry to combat soil degradation, salinization, and nutrient leaching.

By fusing multi-modal NASA Earth observation datasets—including SMAP (root-zone moisture), ECOSTRESS (thermal and evaporative stress), GPM (precipitation), and Landsat (vegetation health)—with local soil parameters, our Chemi-Kinetic Core models critical ion mobility, cation exchange capacity (CEC), and salinization trends. 

Powered by a Reinforcement Learning engine, the Agro-Copilot translates complex chemical and orbital signals into clear, actionable daily guidance and 3–5 year crop rotation strategies. This empowers farmers to make data-driven decisions that conserve water, restore soil organic carbon, and ensure long-term food security.
details: What it does & How it works: C.h.e.MartixAZE is an agricultural decision-support system that bridges multi-modal NASA Earth observation datasets (SMAP, ECOSTRESS, GPM, and Landsat) with local soil chemistry. The platform's Chemi-Kinetic Core analyzes root-zone soil moisture, thermal stress, precipitation patterns, and vegetation health (NDVI) alongside local soil parameters (pH, Cation Exchange Capacity, and organic matter). It models nutrient leaching risks, salinization trends, and humus degradation rates, feeding this data into a Reinforcement Learning engine to generate optimal 3-5 year crop rotation strategies and daily actionable guidance. Benefits & Impact: The project tackles accelerated soil degradation and climate stress by transforming abstract satellite telemetry into the chemical language of soil behavior. It empowers farmers to conserve water, mitigate salinization, and actively restore soil organic carbon for long-term food security. Tools & Technologies Used: - Python (OOP architecture, data fusion and chemi-kinetic algorithms) - NASA Open Data: SMAP, ECOSTRESS, GPM, Landsat - Gamma (for 7-slide interactive presentation design) - Google Drive (cloud hosting and public repository management)
